The '''''Spaceward Ho!''''' was an [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|LAAT/i]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] used during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Characteristics==
This gunship had customized nose art of a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] female in a seductive pose with the words ''"Spaceward Ho!"'' written in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]].<ref name="TCW film">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref><ref name="Storm Over Ryloth Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode019.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Storm Over Ryloth}}</ref>

==History==
[[File:SpacewardHoArt_TCWVG.jpg|thumb|left|''Spaceward Ho!'' nose art]]
''Spaceward Ho!'' was aboard [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]] [[Defiant (Acclamator-class)|''Defiant'']] as it approached [[Teth/Legends|Teth]] just prior to the [[Battle of Teth/Legends|battle]] that took place there.<ref name="TCW film" />

It later appeared on the [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']] at the time of the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]].<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth Ep Guide" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Spaceward Ho!'' shares its name with a [[Wikipedia:Spaceward Ho!|science-fiction computer game]] released in [[1990]].
